description: Defines the FineractEntityAccess class, representing access control between entities in the Fineract system, including creation, JSON parsing, and update methods.

classes.name: FineractEntityAccess
classes.description: Entity class representing access relationships between entities, with methods for creation, JSON deserialization, and updating fields.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Creates a new FineractEntityAccess instance with specified entity types, IDs, and access type.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a FineractEntityAccess object from JSON command input and access type.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the entity access fields based on JSON command input, returning a map of changes.
